## LECTURE SEVEN

### Sinusoidal Model

$$y_t = \beta_0 + \beta_1 \cos(2\pi f t) + \beta_2 \sin(2\pi f t) + \varepsilon_t$$

$f : \text{frequency}$

### Sinusoid

$$s_t = \beta_0 + R \cos(2\pi f t + \Phi)$$

(1) $R$ (Amplitude) : Maximum deviation from the center line $\beta_0$

(2) $f$ (Frequency) : Number
